_meta.note: Single canonical service data layer for all V3 generators. Do not edit the legacy SERVICES object in the generators — edit this file instead.
_meta.function_fields_note: Fields marked _is_function: true were closures in the legacy generator. They are stored here as template strings using {{city.label}}, {{city.label_de}}, {{city.pricing_low}}, {{city.pricing_high}}, {{city.pricing_note}}, {{city.neighborhoods}}, {{city.demand_context}} placeholders. The V3 template engine resolves these at generation time before content-guard runs.
